label: Nginx Zero-Day
advisory:
Emergency advisory
CVE: CVE-2026-21443
Software: nginx
Vulnerable versions: <= 1.24.0
Severity: critical
Fixed version: 1.26.2
IoC IP: 203.0.113.50
IoC User-Agent: ZD-Hunter/6.0

Summary
Demo identifier only. The authoritative CVE-2026-21443 record is OpenEMR XSS, not nginx.
In this lab, nginx at or below 1.24.0 is the fictional affected range. Upgrade target: 1.26.2.
203.0.113.50 scans with ZD-Hunter/6.0 and then POSTs /admin/session 200. The audit line records outcome=attack_completed. web-nginx-01 stays on 1.24.0.
203.0.113.77 is a separate lone scanner and is not this scenario's attacker.

label: PHP CGI RCE (CVE-2024-4577)
advisory:
Emergency advisory
CVE: CVE-2024-4577
Software: PHP
Vulnerable versions: 8.1.x < 8.1.29; 8.2.x < 8.2.20; 8.3.x < 8.3.8
Severity: critical
Fixed version: 8.2.20
IoC IP: 198.51.100.42
IoC Path: /php-cgi/php-cgi.exe

Summary
PHP-CGI on Windows is affected on 8.1 before 8.1.29, 8.2 before 8.2.20, and 8.3 before 8.3.8.
The fix points are 8.1.29, 8.2.20, and 8.3.8. Linux builds are not affected.
The synthetic campaign from 198.51.100.42 probes php-cgi.exe, stages a tool on tools.attacker-lab.example, injects a soft-hyphen argument, runs cmd.exe, reads /admin/config, and posts to the attacker domain.
Sentinel Gnome then records outcome=patched_after_detection. app-php-01 is already at 8.2.20 and is no longer in the vulnerable range.

label: Node.js Windows Command Injection (CVE-2024-27980)
advisory:
Emergency advisory
CVE: CVE-2024-27980
Software: Node.js
Vulnerable versions: 18.x < 18.20.2; 20.x < 20.12.2; 21.x < 21.7.3
Severity: high
Fixed version: 20.12.2
IoC IP: 203.0.113.105

Summary
CVE-2024-27980 is a Windows command injection in child_process.spawn and spawnSync when a .bat or .cmd file is spawned without shell:true. It is not HTTP request smuggling.
Fixed in 18.20.2, 20.12.2, and 21.7.3. CVE-2024-36138 bypassed the first fix; prefer 20.15.1 or later on the 20.x line.
Patch from this advisory. Do not wait for a probe from 203.0.113.105.
api-node-01 is already at 20.12.2. The logs record outcome=patched_from_advisory and contain no exploit line.
